transcript.text: Thanks Priya. I've got the order form up - shall we walk through it?

transcript.text: Yes. From my side we're basically in negotiation now - I just want the order form wording to match our EU entity, Acme Logistics B.V.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Easy change. Anything else on the commercial terms?

transcript.text: We'd want the Rotterdam site invoiced separately, because it runs on its own cost centre.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: That works. I'll send the revised order form with the EU entity and split invoicing by Monday the 14th.

transcript.text: Great. Legal has our standard terms already, so I don't expect surprises there.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Good to hear. Anything that could slow down signature?
